checks.initial_state: 3-service app (nginx + flask + redis) at /home/ga/webapp/ with BASIC compose config: no health checks, no resource limits (mem/cpu), no restart policies, single default network. Stack pre-built and running as basic deployment. Agent must harden the compose file to production standards.
production_requirements: Health checks with appropriate test command, interval, timeout, retries for each service
Resource limits (memory and CPU) for each service to prevent runaway consumption
Restart policies (unless-stopped or on-failure) for each service
Network isolation: frontend network (nginx+app), backend network (app+redis), redis isolated to backend only

scoring.mandatory_for_pass: compose_modified == True AND hc_count > 0 AND score >= 70 (anti-gaming: if compose never modified and no hardening done, score = 0)

criteria.name: health_checks_all_3_services
criteria.check: healthcheck section in all 3 containers via docker inspect

criteria.name: network_isolation
criteria.check: frontend+backend networks exist (10) + redis only on backend (10)

criteria.name: app_accessible_after_hardening
criteria.check: HTTP 200 on port 9080 (only if compose was modified)

anti_gaming.pre_started_app: Setup pre-starts the basic stack so port 9080 responds HTTP 200. The verifier gates app_accessible criterion on compose_modified=True. If the agent does nothing, compose_modified=False and the early-exit returns score=0.
anti_gaming.compose_mtime_check: Export captures compose file mtime vs initial mtime recorded at task start. int(mtime) > TASK_START pattern used to prevent sub-second false positives.

partial_test_1.description: Only health checks added to all 3 services, no limits/restart/networks, app accessible

partial_test_2.description: Health checks + resource limits added, no restart policies or network isolation

occupation_data.rationale: Production hardening of docker-compose deployments (health checks, resource limits, restart policies, network isolation) is a mandatory pre-production checklist item for any containerized application

notes: This task tests knowledge across 4 distinct compose production patterns simultaneously: health probes (liveness/readiness), resource governance (OOM prevention), process supervision (restart on failure), and network segmentation (DMZ pattern). The pyyaml NOT installed constraint in the VM environment required all verification to use docker inspect + grep/awk rather than YAML parsing.

phase4_vm_test.method: Manual SSH pipeline on QEMU VM (port 2380, pre_start checkpoint)
phase4_vm_test.setup_output: webapp stack running at /home/ga/webapp; basic (unhardened) compose deployed
